blocks.text: Original document: [docs/RAYMARCHED_3D_SURFACES_AND_STREAMLINES_ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/RAYMARCHED_3D_SURFACES_AND_STREAMLINES_ARCHITECTURE.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.
Advanced scientific visualizations require real-time GPU computation for mathematical functions that are impractical or inefficient to evaluate via classical CPU polygon triangulation.

items: **[`RaymarchPlot3D`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/plotting/RaymarchPlot3D.ts)**: A 654-line GPU-accelerated implicit and explicit 3D surface raymarcher that visualizes bivariate functions $y = f(x, z)$ in real time across 6 rendering styles and 4 color mapping modes.

**[`Streamlines2D`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/plotting/Streamlines2D.ts)**: A fluidic particle advection engine that simulates and renders flowing streamlines through dynamic 2D vector fields $\vec{F}(x, y, t)$.

**[`ImplicitCurve2DGPU`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/plotting/ImplicitCurve2DGPU.ts)**: GPU-based level-set contour evaluator executing parallel Marching Squares inside WebGPU compute passes.

children.description: Bounding-volume traversal, analytical normal gradients and the PPLL OIT ShaderDomain.

children.label: Visual styles
children.description: SOLID, WIREFRAME, HEATMAP, CONTOUR, DEPTH and TOPOGRAPHY; multi-axis colormaps.

blocks.text: Rather than generating dense polygonal grids on the CPU, `RaymarchPlot3D` bounds the domain $(x, z) \in [x_{\min}, x_{\max}] \times [z_{\min}, z_{\max}]$ inside an oriented bounding box and marches viewing rays inside the fragment shader.

items: The ray intersects the top/bottom domain bounds.
An adaptive sphere-tracing / secant march tracks the signed distance between the ray height and the surface function:
Root convergence $g(t^*) = 0$ identifies the exact surface hit without geometric discretization error.

blocks.text: Surface normals are evaluated analytically via central finite differences:

items: **`WIREFRAME`**: Modulo fractional grid lines evaluated in screen space.
**`TOPOGRAPHIC`**: Solid geological block with stratified internal depth banding and surface contours.

blocks.text: `RaymarchPlot3D` declares a custom `RAYMARCH_DOMAIN` in the shader system, integrating with Retiam's Per-Pixel Linked List (PPLL) A-buffer so transparent mathematical plots cleanly interpenetrate other 3D meshes.
`Streamlines2D` renders animated flow lines through velocity vector fields $\vec{v}(x, y, t)$:

blocks.code: Spawn Particle -> Numerical RK4 Step -> Extrude Ribbon Trail -> Age Decay -> Kill / Respawn

items: **Particle Advection**: Tracer particles follow Runge-Kutta 4th-order (RK4) trajectories:

**Dynamic Ribbon Trails**: Each active particle extrudes a [`Line3D`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/primitives/3d/Line3D.ts) smooth ribbon with round caps and joints.
**Lifecycle Recycling**: When particle age exceeds `maxAge`, it is terminated and respawned randomly across the domain, maintaining steady streamline visual density.
